utterances.text: Look. We start at ten. And we add one more.
Look. Ten. And five more. How many now?
Look. Six and six are the same. They make twelve.
Look. Seven and seven make fourteen.
Look. Eight. And five more. Count on. What do you get?
Look. Nine. And six more. How many altogether?
Look. Eight and eight are the same. They make sixteen.
Look. Nine and nine are the same. They make eighteen.
